Diagnostic summary of a peak catalog

Source: R/peak_catalog.R
catalog_summary.Rd

Returns a list of scalar and small-data-frame summary stats and, when print = TRUE, prints a human-readable summary. Intended as the first thing you look at after build_peak_catalog().

Usage

catalog_summary(
  catalog,
  prevalence_thresholds = c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.99),
  print = TRUE
)

Arguments

catalog

A peak_catalog object.

prevalence_thresholds

Numeric vector of prevalence values at which to report the number of compounds meeting or exceeding that threshold. Default c(0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90, 0.99).

print

If TRUE (default), print a formatted summary in addition to returning the underlying data.

Value

List with n_pool_peaks, n_samples, n_compounds, n_small_clusters, n_singletons, total_observations, fraction_singleton, fraction_below_support, and a data frame compounds_at_threshold with columns prevalence_threshold, n_compounds.
